title: Pipe oxlint before ESLint in pre-commit
resolution: measured on the ts-package template with lefthook 2.2.1: a failing file 0.5 s instead of 2.5 s, a clean file 2.2 s instead of 1.7 s; clean commits dominate, so the hook stays parallel. OXLINT.md records the numbers and the type-aware oxlint caveat (8457615).
